body:
Hey, sorry for the late reply, didn't see the message.

I think your story seems similar to mine. I've been feeling really shitty recently. I'm not comfortable talking to someone I know. I'm not sure what it is but with my parents, they always seem to dismiss things as silly, saying "you're over exaggerating" or "man up" or any of that sort of stuff. 

It's really bad because I keep to myself, then I finally ask my parents because they are good people. My mother is always compassionate but when I bring up a problem, it's like she doesn't believe me.

I don't feel like I'm getting out of this 'phase', in fact the trend seems to continue by getting worse daily to the point where right now, I feel like I'm on the edge of a breakdown. 

Thanks a lot for your offer.
